The '''1943 National Division''' was the sixth edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] won their third title.

==Participants==

*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Ankara Demirspor]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[Gençlerbirliği S.K.|Gençlerbirliği]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*[[Göztepe S.K.|UDV Göztepe]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 1st
*[[Altınordu F.K.|Altınordu]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
